# BookmarkItemOptions

<!-- Generated from the doc comments in the library. Do not edit this file. -->

Options for [`BookmarkItem`](bookmark-item.md). Nested `children` accept literals too.

Import from `@bonniepdf/core`.

```typescript
type BookmarkItemOptions = Partial<Omit<Pick<BookmarkItem, (typeof BOOKMARK_ITEM_OPTION_KEYS)[number]>, 'children'>> & {
    /** Child bookmarks; each may be an instance or its own options literal. */
    children?: (BookmarkItem | BookmarkItemOptions)[];
}
```

## Properties

- [`children`](#children): Child bookmarks; each may be an instance or its own options literal.
- [`pageIndex`](#pageindex): The 0-based page index this bookmark navigates to.
